Name: AT - Peachy Seasonal Set
Author: peachitto
Description:
i just wanted to make some fun little options for fall-themed furniture, but i might do other seasons in the future. maybe! these are mostly just recolored/remixed edits of vanilla art, with some stuff made from scratch. i was in a bit of rush to post this before halloween, so i didn't get in-game pictures of everything or check everything because i kept adding things afterwards. let me know if it's messed up somewhere.

the previews (not the in-game ones) show every option with what you have to use the paint bucket on to get it. i am making use of the "collective" feature for Alternative Textures, so every object to the left of an arrow can be turned into every object to the right of the arrow. hopefully the images make sense!

there is now an optional season-specific version you can use (even alongside the main version if you want). thanks to glymr for the idea and putting in the initial work to make it and sharing it with me!
so, the main version shows up year-round in the paint can menu and on your furniture. the optional season-specific version will only appear in the paint can menu during fall, and anything changed to this version will revert to vanilla textures on season change. you can use both so you can even pick and choose if you want certain things seasonal or not.

(i think) i had to redo my main version so if you are updating from 1.0 you will want to delete that version entirely and then install the new version. unfortunately this will revert anything you had changed using the old version. but hopefully i won't need to redo it anymore. ^_^'
